data.focus: Do your best, ensure code is high quality and you follow all ACs both main specs and attached traits. Be thorough. After submitting a PR run /codex PR and fix any issues it brings up. Ensure when spawning codex that you instruct it that it is running inside of a kspec ralph loop and in no uncertain terms should it blanket kill processes especially kspec or kspec ralph ones. Ensure the code you're writing is tested, reviewed and not only matches the letter of the tasks, specs, and AC but also the spirit. Do better, do more, be proactive and succeed!
